title: Block Out Level 24 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 24 is a shared-corridor double-boss board with two framed `12` panels. Thin the right pillar ladder first, open the central shaft second, and let the upper boss fall before the lower one follows.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 24 is a shared-corridor double-boss board with two framed `12` panels. Thin the right pillar ladder first, open the central shaft second, and let the upper boss fall before the lower one follows.
landmarks: Block Out Level 24 is a shared-corridor double-boss board with two framed `12` panels.
Thin the right pillar ladder first, open the central shaft second, and let the upper boss fall before the lower one follows.
The board mixes Purple, Red, White and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Open the shaft before moving the bosses.
The upper `12` goes before the lower `12`.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Thin the right ladder of black, red, and white blocks before touching either framed boss.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Open the central shaft near the top `12` panel so the two bosses stop sharing a sealed corridor.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Lower the upper `12` panel once the right edge is no longer crowded.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the freed shaft to begin dropping the lower `12` panel afterward.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Keep the red top gate for late cleanup after the shaft has opened.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Drain the remaining side counters and small color pieces as the second boss falls.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the last right-column leftovers after both `12` panels are nearly gone.

failurePoints: Trying to move one boss while the shared shaft is still blocked.
Using the top red gate before the right corridor has thinned enough.
